nodes.label: BeatGaler
nodes.subtitle: Current code reality
nodes.details: Only systems proven by the current mapping appear here.

nodes.label: Playback
nodes.subtitle: Turn a Play request into continuous audio
nodes.details: Relationships in this view are not execution order.

nodes.label: Know which beat is current
nodes.subtitle: Older tracked Play requests cannot take over
nodes.details: The latest Web playback intent identifies the requested beat still allowed to become active.

nodes.label: Know where the audio lives
nodes.subtitle: beat → Telegram message
nodes.details: A local routing cache stores the Telegram message and media information needed to locate the MASTER.

nodes.label: Prioritize the playing beat
nodes.subtitle: Playback gets Direct focus over background work
nodes.details: The active Telegram message receives playback focus instead of background warm priority.

nodes.label: Prepare playable audio
nodes.subtitle: Reuse warm bytes or obtain what is missing
nodes.details: Matching warm work is adopted or promoted instead of discarded and redownloaded.

nodes.label: Keep playback supplied
nodes.subtitle: Continue streaming from retained bytes
nodes.details: The stream continues from the retained prefix byte offset rather than restarting at zero.

nodes.label: Start Playback
nodes.subtitle: Open the actual execution sequence
nodes.details: Enter this flow to see execution order.

nodes.label: User chooses a beat
nodes.subtitle: Create a new current Play intent
nodes.details: A new Web playback intent is created for the selected beat.

nodes.label: BeatGaler resolves its audio route
nodes.subtitle: Use the cached beat → Telegram message mapping
nodes.details: The Web adapter resolves the Telegram message from the playback routing cache.

nodes.label: Playback source becomes ready
nodes.subtitle: Use the shared startup/playback coordinator
nodes.details: The Web path resolves the shared coordinator/source manager and checks that the intent is still current.

nodes.label: This beat gets playback priority
nodes.subtitle: Existing warm work is adopted or promoted when possible
nodes.details: Matching prefetch work is promoted/adopted and the message receives playback focus.

nodes.label: Playable bytes are prepared
nodes.subtitle: Reuse active playback, replay cache or a warm prefix when available
nodes.details: The source manager reuses existing playable data or prepares MediaSource/Blob playback.

nodes.label: Browser receives a playable URL
nodes.subtitle: The beginning can be available before the full file
nodes.details: MediaSource allows a playable URL to exist while later bytes are still arriving.

nodes.label: Streaming continues from what is already retained
nodes.subtitle: offset = retained prefix byte length
nodes.details: When a usable prefix exists, streaming continues at prefix.byteLength instead of byte zero.

nodes.label: If the route is stale, reconcile and retry
nodes.subtitle: Only for ROUTE_MISSING / MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE
nodes.details: A recoverable route failure refreshes authoritative library state and retries with a repaired route.

nodes.label: If a newer Play wins, stop this request
nodes.subtitle: Superseded tracked playback does not take over
nodes.details: Intent checks prevent stale preparation from replacing the newest selected beat.
